svg.aria-label: Sixty-one daily dials of sunlight, one per day, each a petal of hourly values opening upward from midnight at the bottom to noon at the top
svg.text: one dial per day · midnight below, noon above · distance from centre: the light that hour
The record begins on a late afternoon (first dial) and ends the afternoon sixty-one days later (last). Read left to right, row by row.
